note: Simple student meals. Quantities are for one serving; units match grocery_prices.json.

recipes.name: Tomato and egg on rice
recipes.steps: Cook the rice. Scramble the eggs softly, take them out. Fry the tomato with a pinch of sugar and salt until soft, add the eggs back.

recipes.name: Fish ball congee with egg
recipes.steps: Simmer the rice in plenty of water for 30 minutes, stirring. Add the fish balls and ginger, crack in an egg at the end.

recipes.name: Instant noodles upgrade
recipes.steps: Boil the noodles with the cabbage. Fry the luncheon meat and an egg on the side, put them on top.

recipes.name: Garlic stir-fried greens with rice
recipes.steps: Cook the rice. Fry the chopped garlic, add the cabbage, a splash of water and oyster sauce, cover for 2 minutes.

recipes.name: Simple mapo tofu
recipes.steps: Fry the beef with chili bean sauce, add the tofu in cubes and a little water, simmer 5 minutes, thicken with corn starch. Serve on rice.

recipes.name: Steamed egg with rice
recipes.steps: Beat the eggs with warm water (1.5 times their volume), steam 10 minutes on low heat, finish with soy sauce and sesame oil.

recipes.name: Luncheon meat fried rice
recipes.steps: Use rice cooked the day before. Fry the diced luncheon meat and vegetables, add the egg, then the rice and soy sauce.

recipes.name: Soy sauce chicken wings with rice
recipes.steps: Brown the wings, add soy sauce, sugar and a little water, cover and simmer 15 minutes, reduce the sauce.

recipes.name: Spaghetti with tomato sauce and sausage
recipes.steps: Boil the spaghetti. Slice and fry the sausages, add the sauce, mix in the pasta.

recipes.name: Tuna and egg sandwiches
recipes.steps: Boil an egg 9 minutes, mash it with the tuna and mayonnaise, fill the bread.

recipes.name: Udon soup with egg and greens
recipes.steps: Heat the broth with some water, add the udon and cabbage for 3 minutes, poach an egg in it.

recipes.name: Potato curry chicken wings with rice
recipes.steps: Brown the wings, add potato and carrot in chunks, the curry sauce and water to cover, simmer 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Fish ball rice vermicelli soup
recipes.steps: Soak the vermicelli, boil it in the broth with the fish balls and cabbage for 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Oats with milk and banana
recipes.steps: Cook the oats in the milk for 3 minutes, slice the banana on top.

recipes.name: Shrimp and broccoli stir-fry with rice
recipes.steps: Blanch the broccoli. Fry the garlic and shrimp until pink, add the broccoli, a little salt and corn starch water.
